text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and D at large gains felt rewarding, but later buying Stock A at a much lower price reminds me not to let the satisfaction of realizing gains replace a consistent, portfolio-wide plan.","I should size purchases with care: after adding to A, B and D in Period 8, the account fell in Period 10, and I need to judge exposure by overall risk rather than confidence in any single trade.","Doing nothing during declines avoids impulsive reactions, but I should still review whether each holding and my cash allocation fit my goals instead of treating inaction as a strategy."]}
